newsitem.title: UK: London sugar freight - Brazil features strongly.
newsitem.headline: London sugar freight - Brazil features strongly.

text.p: Brazil was prominent as an origin for many of the fixtures and enquiries circulating on the sugar freight market on Thursday, brokers said.
Fixtures - E.D.and F Man 14,000 bagged Brazil to Lagos mid July about $33.
Cargill 14,000 bulk from Corinto to Baltic, Egypt or Black Sea prompt and 30,000 bulk Santos to Iran prompt, probably in the low $30s.
Dreyfus fixed 14,000 bagged from Vitoria to Parangua to the Red Sea, no rate.
Lorico 10,000 baggged Rio de Janeiro to Egypt mid July about $35.
New Business - E.D. and F.Man 25,000 bulk Parangua to Black Sea July 15/21.
Simab 14,000 bagged Brazil to Lagos July 10/15.
Dreyfus 14,000/18,000 bagged South Brazil to Red Sea July 15/25.
Czarnikow 25,000 bulk Parangua to Morocco for mid-July.
